add.issue.name: A lane's done mark shows whether its tickets count as done, the Done-named fallback included

edit.description.md:
From review of PR #522.

The TUI ✓, the GUI header check and the panel checkbox all read `laneRules(lane).includes('done')`. Goal progress reads `isDoneLane`, which also counts a lane named Done on a board where no lane has the rule.

- A board's "Done" lane counts its tickets done, but it carries no mark and its checkbox is unchecked.
- Ticking the rule on any other lane silently stops "Done" counting. Nothing on screen says so, and its pill drops.

Fix: project the effect (`isDoneLane`) as a field on ApiSwimlane/GuiSwimlane, and draw the mark from it. Let the panel say why: "a lane named Done counts while no lane has this rule". Keep the checkbox for the explicit rule.

add.issue.name: Lane rules are named and checked once, in a module the GUI client can import

edit.description.md:
From review of PR #522.

- The rule is restated as the literal `'done'` in GuiSwimlane.rules, SwimlaneDetails.onSetRule and use-swimlane-editing.setSwimlaneRule.
  - lane-rules.ts imports state, so the client can't import LaneRule from it.
  - Move LANE_RULES, LaneRule and the labels into a pure module, as other `*.model.ts` files are, and import it on both sides.
- LANE_RULE_LABELS is exported and used nowhere. The panel restates it as "Tickets here count as done". Use it, or drop it.
- The "already has this rule" check is written three times, with different outcomes for a no-op:
  - nodeRepo.addLaneRule fails;
  - mcp/api setSwimlaneRule succeeds with "No changes made";
  - TUI lane-rule.cmd fails with its own message.
  Settle on one behaviour.
- lane-rules.ts imports Swimlane and isSwimlaneNode from the same module in two statements.

add.issue.name: The lane panel's names say details, not stats, and its header renames by a focusable control

edit.description.md:
From review of PR #522.

Stale names after the panel gained Overview:
- App: statsSwimlaneId / setStatsSwimlaneId / statsSwimlane (25 uses).
- Test ids: `swimlane-stats` (the panel), `swimlane-stats-title`, `swimlane-stats-title-input`.
- `swimlane-menu` sits on a button that opens the panel, not a menu.

Controls:
- The ⋮ button draws a text glyph. IconDots already exists (CommitRow uses it).
- DetailsHeader's rename is a `span` with onClick: no focus, no keyboard path, and nothing says it is editable except the cursor. ManageGoalsModal's rename is a real `button` (cursor: text) with the same Input after it. Reuse that shape.

add.issue.name: Lane rule tests use their own lane and a helper for setting a rule

edit.description.md:
From review of PR #522.

- lane-rules.pw.ts marks the seeded board's first lane done and relies on a finally block to undo it. That lane is shared by every test in the worker, and a failed uncheck leaves every later goal pill counting differently. swimlane-panel.pw.ts already creates its own lane with addLane: do the same.
- lane-rules.test.ts repeats the 8-line `unwrap(await setSwimlaneRule({repoRoot, swimlaneId, rule: 'done', on}))` block six times. A `setDone(laneId, on)` in seed() halves the file.
